# agent-browser core

agent-browser drives Chrome over CDP from the command line. A snapshot returns the page's accessibility tree with a compact `@eN` ref for each element, and you act on those refs. This guide covers the loop and the common web tasks. Detailed flags, edge cases, and specialized workflows live in references and other skills; [Load more when you need it](#load-more-when-you-need-it) says which one to load for what.

## Always use your own session

Before your first command, get a session name for the task. It is stable for the worktree, so running it again prints the same name:

```bash
agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task   # prints a name such as task-be5442ae6b6b
```

Pass that name with `--session <name>` on every command. Many agent harnesses run each command in a new shell, so an `export AGENT_BROWSER_SESSION=...` is gone by the next command, which then runs in the default session. Export the variable only when every command runs in the same shell.

The default unnamed session is one browser shared with every other agent on the machine, and it persists across conversations. Working in it can take over another agent's page or navigate away from something the human left open. Examples below omit `--session` for brevity; add it to each command.

## The core loop

```bash
agent-browser open <url>        # 1. Open a page
agent-browser snapshot -i       # 2. See what's on it (interactive elements only)
agent-browser click @e3         # 3. Act on refs from the snapshot
agent-browser snapshot -i       # 4. Re-snapshot after any page change
```

Refs stay valid for elements that survive a same-document update. Take a fresh snapshot after navigation or to observe page changes.

Prefer snapshots. Take a screenshot only when the user asks for one, or for something the DOM cannot represent, such as a canvas. Never screenshot to check whether an element exists or the page finished loading. If the snapshot is missing an element you expect, the page is usually still loading: wait for it (`wait --text "<text you expect>"` or `wait @eN`, see [Waiting](#waiting)) and snapshot again. A snapshot is faster and uses far fewer tokens.

# 修复业委会选举表决详情页行政区域不显示（bug 5239）

## 一、前因后果
禅道 bug 5239：客测环境「业主自治 > 业委会选举表决详情」页的「行政区域」显示 `-`，期望正常回显单据所属行政区域。实机复现与接口取数证实：详情接口返回的是 `region` 字段，`regionCode` 为 null，而页面只读取 `form.regionCode`，导致格式化后为空。

## 二、现状与证据
- E1 `zhi2-web-admin/src/views/autonomy/election/owner/vote/detail.vue:645-650`：`detailCallback` 仅 `{...this.form, ...response.data}`，未做区域字段映射；`regionCode` 初值见 `:327` 为 `undefined`。
- E2 `zhi2-web-admin/src/views/autonomy/election/owner/vote/detail.vue:460-463`：查看态 `contentInfo` 用 `formatters.provinceFormatter('', {property:'regionCode'}, this.form.regionCode)` 渲染行政区域，空值经 `src/formatters/index.js:164-165` 返回空串，页面显示 `-`。
- E3 实机复现（agent-browser，test 环境 `http://localhost:8167/#/autonomy/ywhgl/ownerElection/vote/2092206130858582016?formMode=view`）：详情页「行政区域：-」；禅道截图 `D:\禅道附件\bug\5239\file18375_*.png` 为同一现象。
- E4 接口取数：`GET /api/v2.0/autonomy/decision/2092206130858582016` 返回 `region='110101'`、`regionCode=null`；库表 `ZHISHU_AUTONOMY.T_DECISION` 只有 `REGION` 列、无 `REGION_CODE` 列。
- E5 同仓先例 `a0cfe608b`（加梯申报详情页行政区域不显示）：在 `detailCallback` 中补 `regionCode: response.data.regionCode || response.data.region`，并让展示值优先取 `regionName`。本次沿用同一映射思路。
- E6 子模块当前脏文件为 `ScreenHeader.vue`、`particles.js`、`_review.json`，与目标文件无交集。

| 步骤 | 落点文件:函数 | 改动 | 验证 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `src/views/autonomy/election/owner/vote/detail.vue` `detailCallback` | 在展开 `response.data` 后补一行映射：`regionCode = response.data.regionCode || response.data.region`，兼容接口只返回 `region` 的历史数据 | ESLint + test 构建 |
| 2 | 同文件 `contentInfo` 的「行政区域」项 | 展示值优先取 `form.regionName`，再回退 `provinceFormatter(..., form.regionCode || form.region)`，与同仓先例一致，避免查看态仍为空 | ESLint + test 构建 |
